title: INTRODUCTORY MATHEMATICS I
modules: Equations, Functions, And Change Of Subject Of
Linear Equations And Linear Simultaneous Equation
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a fundamental concept in calculus that measures the rate of change of one variable with respect to another."
Differentiation is a fundamental concept in calculus that measures the rate of change of one variable with respect to another.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a relationship or expression involving one or more variables."
A function is a relationship or expression involving one or more variables.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used to represent limits, scarcity, and optimal decision conditions."
Inequalities are used to represent limits, scarcity, and optimal decision conditions.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a whole number (integer) or algebraic expression that divides another number or expression completely without leaving any remainder."
A factor is a whole number (integer) or algebraic expression that divides another number or expression completely without leaving any remainder.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used when a value is not included, while closed circles indicate inclusion."
Open circles are used when a value is not included, while closed circles indicate inclusion.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used when we wish to locate a point in coordinate geometry."
A similar principle is used when we wish to locate a point in coordinate geometry.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the factors that a pair of numbers or algebraic terms has in common. 1 is a common factor of all sets of numbers, but sometimes it may not be the only common factor, except when the numbers are prime."

Common Factors Common factors are the factors that a pair of numbers or algebraic terms has in common. 1 is a common factor of all sets of numbers, but sometimes it may not be the only common factor, except when the numbers are prime.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the simplification of an expression by dividing it by the highest common factor."
Factorisation is the simplification of an expression by dividing it by the highest common factor.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a mathematical statement that says one side equals the other."
An equation is a mathematical statement that says one side equals the other.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the lowest value among the set of common multiples."
The lowest common multiple is the lowest value among the set of common multiples.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is called the derivative of y with respect to x, and it measures the rate of increase of y with respect to x."
The value of dy/dx is called the derivative of y with respect to x, and it measures the rate of increase of y with respect to x.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the dependent variable or subject of the relation."
The component of the LHS is the dependent variable or subject of the relation.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the results obtained when a constant number multiplies a set of natural numbers."
Multiples are the results obtained when a constant number multiplies a set of natural numbers.
fib: ______ is the simplest form of an equation.
linear equation
A linear equation is the simplest form of an equation.
______ is derived from the completing-the-squares method.
formula method
The formula method is derived from the completing-the-squares method.
______ is used to show the relationships among objects or finite groups of things.
Venn diagram
A Venn diagram is used to show the relationships among objects or finite groups of things.
______ is a quadratic expression that has the same term after factorisation.
perfect square
A perfect square is a quadratic expression that has the same term after factorisation.
______ is a set of linear equations in which the number of equations equals the number of unknowns.
simultaneous linear equation
A simultaneous linear equation is a set of linear equations in which the number of equations equals the number of unknowns.
______ is used when the inequality includes equality, while a dashed boundary line is used when it does not.
solid boundary line
A solid boundary line is used when the inequality includes equality, while a dashed boundary line is used when it does not.
______ are the inverse of exponential functions.
Logarithmic functions
Logarithmic functions are the inverse of exponential functions.
______ is the decomposition of an object, a number, or a polynomial into a product of other objects or factors which, when multiplied together, give the original.
Factorisation or factoring
Factorisation or factoring is the decomposition of an object, a number, or a polynomial into a product of other objects or factors which, when multiplied together, give the original.
______ is a function in which the dependent variable is not isolated on one side of the equation.
implicit function
An implicit function is a function in which the dependent variable is not isolated on one side of the equation.
______ is a function in which the dependent variable can be written explicitly.
explicit function
An explicit function is a function in which the dependent variable can be written explicitly.
______ is used in the process of factorisation, not any common factor.
Only the highest common factor
Only the highest common factor is used in the process of factorisation, not any common factor.
